summary: Added strict OpenAI-compatible embedding JSONL datasets to bench_serving and real encode-mode support to offline_throughput, with embedding-only metrics, Ray compatibility, documentation, and adversarial regressions.

tests.what_was_measured: 49 tests and 6 subtests covering embedding dataset dispatch, payload preservation, token counts, malformed and undersized inputs, backend compatibility, and offline encode-vs-generate behavior.
Repository formatting, lint, spelling, syntax, and registered-test policy hooks for every changed file.
Real MI355X HTTP transport and engine execution with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, including per-record OpenAI parameters and expected rejection of unsupported dimensions.

tests.command: Independent transformers AutoModel GPU forward compared with SGLang /v1/embeddings
tests.what_was_measured: Two 1024-dimensional outputs had cosine similarity 0.9997416 and 0.9998755 against independent last-token-pooled, L2-normalized references.
Fresh-engine offline encoding completed two requests, 19 input tokens, and reported encoding throughput without generation metrics.

remaining_limitations: vLLM request compatibility is unit-tested, but no vLLM server was installed or executed.
Offline embedding JSONL accepts one string per record and a common optional dimensions value; input arrays and other OpenAI-only fields explicitly require the online benchmark.
No native C++ changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
